elements.element: The transition and data-return obligations apply upon expiration or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Clause (a) requires TrueLink to “provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) specifies “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at TrueLink's then-current rates.
TrueLink must return all Client data to Client.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires TrueLink to “return to Client all Client data.”

elements.element: Client data must be returned within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) imposes a deadline of “within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Client data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: TrueLink must delete the returned Client data from its systems thereafter.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: TrueLink must certify deletion of the Client data to Client thereafter.
elements.evidence: Clause (c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing.”

elements.element: The transition-assistance and data-export obligations apply upon expiration or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months encompasses the fallback's 90-day period.

elements.element: TrueLink must export or return Client data to Client.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return of all Client data in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires return within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the preferred position and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It includes the required trigger, six-month transition period, then-current rates, unconditional 30-day data return in the specified format, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The existing termination mechanics remain unchanged, and the added details are directly related to the requested transition and data-return obligations.
